x-quota-accounting.send_message: One client message, one global message, one global operation and one session request per new accepted job; commands also count.
x-quota-accounting.get_status_assess_offer_readiness_export: One global operation and one session request per new accepted job; no messages.
x-quota-accounting.start_session: One client session per new session; no global operation or message.
x-quota-accounting.get_result: Minute quota only; no operation, session request or message.
x-quota-accounting.replay: Same request_id and arguments consumes minute quota only; changed arguments cause 409.
x-quota-accounting.requests_per_minute: All valid authenticated tool calls use fixed UTC minute buckets; rejected transactions roll back quota increments.
x-quota-accounting.reset: Daily counters reset at 00:00 UTC; minute counters reset at the next minute. Sessions expire seven days after creation; 100 requests is a lifetime limit.
x-quota-accounting.retry_after: 429 minute/daily responses include Retry-After seconds and reset_at; lifetime 429 has no reset and retry_same_session=false.

info.title: Tool Offer Agent restricted machine adapter
info.description: Source-attributed API/MCP offer intake, conversation, drafting, revision, deterministic readiness assessment and exports. No wallet connection, checkout, FAHCE execution, payment, approval, publication, administration or cross-conversation recovery through this adapter.

x-capabilities: Read public API/MCP documentation and retain source-attributed evidence.
Collect seller-stated customer, pricing, payment, access and invocation terms.
Draft, review and revise an offer within an isolated conversation.
Explain the buyer offer and prepare listing guidance without publication.
Assess retained offer readiness deterministically without inference or payment.
Export structured and human-readable records, with verified multipart retrieval when needed.

drafting.terms: Drafting is free; operator inference costs and published quotas still apply.

evaluation.terms: Optional FAHCE evaluation is separate and buyer-authorized: 0.15 USDC on Base mainnet via the private human checkout. A free preflight is not an evaluation. Checkout preparation, wallet connection and a 402 challenge are not payment authorization, settlement or a completed result. Changed price, network, token or recipient stops payment. No automatic spending.
evaluation.checkout_access: In native chat, wallet explains setup; check prepares an eligible private checkout only when explicitly requested. The buyer reviews the exact request and separately signs there. purchase status retrieves the existing outcome; never purchase again to resolve uncertainty.

scopes.tool_offer:machine: Bounded offer preparation and exports; no payment or administration.

items.description: Public P-256 EC JWK only; private fields rejected. No remote jwks_uri fetch.

client_assertion.description: ES256 private_key_jwt: iss=sub=client_id, aud=exact endpoint, iat, exp<=iat+120 seconds, fresh jti. Replay rejected.

body.description: Exact JSON: schema TOOL_OFFER_ACCESS_ENROLL_V1, name (2..100), use_case (10..1000), identity {type:uagents,address:caller agent1 address}, RSA-OAEP-256 public_key JWK (2048/3072/4096 bits), status_secret_sha256 (SHA-256 of applicant-generated tar_ + 32 random base64url bytes), issued_at (UTC milliseconds within 60 seconds), nonce (fresh UUID v4).

signature.description: uAgents secp256k1 signature over SHA-256 of TOOL_OFFER_ACCESS_ENROLL_V1 followed by newline and exact body. The caller's existing identity signs, never the operator.

body.description: Domain-separated TOOL_OFFER_ACCESS_OWNER_V1 JSON with action list/revoke/audit, request_id (client ID for revoke/audit), issued_at UTC milliseconds and nonce UUID; expires after 60 seconds.

post.description: Send field: value lines, or a JSON-serialized StructuredIntake object in message, a product question, a revision or a drafting command. Intake keys: tool_url, docs (URL string or 1–3 URL strings), customer, pricing, payment, access, invocation; optional job and seller_name. All other values are strings. Optional schema is TOOL_OFFER_INTAKE_V1. Unknown/duplicate keys and invalid values reject the entire update. Card selections are separate. May use bounded operator model quota. Returns a stable job; optional HTTP Prefer: wait=1 through wait=5 waits without redispatch and may include the signed completed result. Otherwise poll get_result. Never resend uncertain work with a new request_id. No payments or FAHCE execution. May overwrite seller fields or rebuild retained drafts; not read-only. Request-ID deduplication is bounded by retained session/job lifetime, not an unqualified retry guarantee.
